policy.title: Cancellation policy
policy.intro: Decide how much you refund when a client cancels. You can have several policies and set one as default. If the seller cancels, the client is always fully refunded.
policy.usingStandard: You don't have your own policies yet: the standard one applies.
policy.editHelp: Each row says: if the client cancels at least that many hours ahead, you refund that percentage. A row at 0 hours is always required; it also applies to no-shows.
policy.name: Policy name

myServices.title: My services
myServices.intro: What clients can book. For each service choose price, duration and cancellation policy; then, if you like, create discounted offers.
myServices.empty: You have no services yet. Create one to get started.
myServices.priceHint: Minimum €1. The service fee is added for the client.
myServices.policyHelp: Choose how much you refund if the client cancels. Use your default or edit the tiers for this offer only. Existing bookings keep the policy that applied when they were made.

errors.title: Give the offer a title.

offers.title: My offers
offers.intro: An offer is a variant of one of your services, with a discount and validity: specific days, a period, weekdays or time ranges.
offers.needService: You need a service before you can create an offer.
offers.priceHint: Full price: the discount is applied on top. Minimum €1.
offers.policyHelp: Choose how much you refund if the client cancels: the service's policy or tiers just for this offer.

errors.ranges: Check the time ranges: from time to time, e.g. 09:00 – 13:00.

offers.deleteWarning: Delete this offer? It will no longer be visible or bookable. You can find it in "Past offers".
offers.pastHelp: Deleted offers: existing bookings stay valid.

availability.title: Availability
availability.intro: Choose when you can be booked. “Available now” makes you callable right away for a few hours; the weekly schedule applies to all your services, except those (or offers) with their own schedule. Times are Rome time.
availability.generalHint: Choose the period and, for each day, 1 to 5 time ranges in 15-minute steps. A closed day offers no times.
availability.outside: You have {{count}} bookings outside the new schedule: they stay valid.
availability.closedHint: Holidays and days off: they apply to all availability, including specific ones.
availability.previewHint: The times clients will see, already without bookings and closed days.
availability.confirmRemove: Going back to the default availability deletes the specific one (when you save). Continue?

slotLinks.title: Send slots
slotLinks.intro: For people who contacted you outside the app: create a link with your free times and share it. Whoever receives it picks a time and pays.
slotLinks.needService: You need a service before creating a link.
slotLinks.priceHint: Full service price: {{amount}}. You can change it for this link only.
slotLinks.daysHint: Choose the days the link applies to. Times that are already taken stay excluded.
slotLinks.extraHint: Added to the price only if the client chooses this place.
slotLinks.messagePlaceholder: Hi! Here are my free times for next week
slotLinks.createdBody: Share it however you like (message, email, social). It expires after the last day offered.

calls.title: Call
calls.howItWorks: You only pay for the minutes you are connected. The seller has 60 seconds to answer: if they don't answer or decline, you pay nothing. If the line drops, you pay up to the last moment you were connected.
calls.hold: When you start we hold {{amount}} on your card (the first {{minutes}} minutes); at the end we only charge the minutes used and the rest is released.
calls.limits: At least {{min}} minutes are charged ({{minAmount}} with the fee) and at most {{max}} minutes per call. Each extra quarter of an hour is held automatically on the same card.
calls.ringLeft: You have {{seconds}} seconds left to answer.
calls.extendFailed: We can't hold more minutes on the card: the call will end in {{time}}.
calls.droppedNote: The line dropped: minutes are counted up to the last moment you were both connected.
calls.limitNote: The call ended because the minutes held on the payment ran out.
calls.nativeNotReady: Video calls from the phone arrive with the next version of the app. For now they work from the browser.
calls.rateHint: At least €0.50 per minute. The client only pays for the connected minutes (5 to 60 minutes per call).
